when there are no orders. Other behaviour must stay the same.

To fix the root cause, we need to handle the case where there are no orders in the `average_order_value` function. We can do this by checking if the length of the orders list is zero and returning 0.0 if it is.

```edit_file
  "new": "return round(total / len(orders), 2) if orders else 0.0"
}
```

After making this change, I will run the tests to ensure that the fix works as expected.
